answers.q: What is the latest Elon Musk news today?
answers.a: As of 26 Oct 2026: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt to buy AI chips arriving in 2027, though Bloomberg reported pricing talks were still under way. SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special board committees of independent directors to review a possible merger; no terms have been agreed. Musk said Starship Flight 15, which is set to attempt the first tower catch of the ship itself, could fly within about four to six weeks of mid-October.
